name: build_trtllm_mha_page_table
description: TRT-LLM MHA page-table construction with signature build_trtllm_mha_page_table(req_to_token, req_pool_indices, cache_seqlens, page_table, page_size). For each request row i, let pool = req_pool_indices[i] and n_pages = ceil(cache_seqlens[i]/page_size). For p < n_pages write page_table[i, p] = req_to_token[pool, p*page_size] // page_size, cast to page_table.dtype; entries p >= n_pages are left unchanged. The wrapper writes page_table in place and returns that same tensor, so page_table is mutated and aliased by the output. The reference returns an updated clone. The native path has a contiguous power-of-two fast path and a strided general path. Int32 inputs are exercised.
